name: Valuation competence

subjectOf.text: Because structured debt instruments and over-the-counter derivatives used by hedge funds can be highly complex, the hedge fund manager may be the only person competent to assess their value.
subjectOf.abstract: As structured debt instruments and over-the-counter derivatives used by hedge funds can be highly complex, the hedge fund manager may be the only person who is in a position to competently assess the value. This unique competency is particularly
subjectOf.citation: Kaal, Hedge Fund Valuation Retailization, Regulation, and Investor Suitability (2009). SSRN: https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=1428387
scope_conditions: for highly complex structured debt and OTC derivatives

subjectOf.text: Outsourcing valuation to an independent administrator can be nominal rather than real: the administrator may lack the understanding of complex securities products needed to value the positions, so the manager remains in charge of valuation even though the function has formally been externalized.
